nodes.asset_description: A computer monitor displaying a website titled “Savoir-Vivre Clique” sits on a white desk. Beside it, a green and white checkered mug rests on the desk. A pair of legs, clad in orange and yellow striped socks and blue jeans, lie casually on the desk. A white mug with a green and white checkered pattern is visible nearby. Above the monitor, two wooden shelves hold a radio, books, a framed photo, and decorative objects. The wall behind the shelves is white.

A young woman with long red hair and glasses sits cross-legged on a patterned rug, wearing a light green long-sleeved shirt and pink pants. She holds a blue pen in her right hand and looks down at a black laptop computer placed on her lap. In front of her is a spiral-bound notebook and a black tablet computer resting on the rug. A black leather couch is visible in the background to the right, and a wooden table with a lamp is partially visible to the left.

An orange, glossy mushroom-shaped lamp sits atop a stack of three books on a wooden surface. The lamp has a rounded base and a wide, dome-like top. A white cord extends from the base of the lamp to the left. To the right of the lamp, a small black and white photograph rests on the books. The background is a plain white wall.

A person wearing a white long-sleeved shirt is seated at a wooden table, typing on a silver laptop. The laptop screen displays a recipe image showing a bowl of food with orange slices and a fork. A stack of books rests to the left, and an orange bowl filled with oranges sits behind the laptop. The person’s hands are positioned on the laptop’s keyboard.
